risks.risk: Console may not be PS4 Pro (could be a standard PS4), which changes value.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the console model label/serial sticker showing the exact model (CUH-7xxx for Pro) or a photo of the 'System' -> 'System Information' screen.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a standard PS4 (worst case vs Pro).

risks.risk: Games may be fewer than 10 or not included at all.
risks.proof: A photo showing all game discs/cases laid out with a visible count (10) or a video panning across the full set.

risks.risk: Controllers may be missing, not included, or may have faults (drift, non-working buttons).
risks.proof: A video showing both controllers connected and working (buttons, sticks, triggers) plus a quick screen recording of controller input responding.
risks.if_unproven: Price as only the console (controllers not guaranteed working).

risks.risk: Console condition may be poor despite 'very clean' claim (overheating, loud fan, damaged ports).
risks.proof: A short test video: console boots to home screen, plays a game for a few minutes, and shows no overheating warnings; also show all ports (HDMI, USB) clearly.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested / potential faults.

risks.risk: Region/compatibility or account lock issues (less common but possible).
risks.proof: Photo/video of the console settings showing it is signed out / primary console status and that it can install/run a disc.
risks.if_unproven: Price as standard used console with no guarantees.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the console model label (CUH number) or 'System Information' screen to confirm PS4 Pro.
Photo/video showing all 10 games (discs/cases) with a visible count.
Photo/video of the two actual controllers (not only boxes) and a quick functional test (no stick drift, all buttons work).
Boot/test video: power on to home screen and run a game briefly; show ports (HDMI/USB) clearly.
response.reason: From photo 0, I can’t reliably confirm the console is PS4 Pro, can’t verify the 10 games, and can’t confirm the two controllers are included and working. Without these, a safe worst-case price can’t be set confidently.
